questions.question: A logistics company needs to identify each parcel in a warehouse photo and return the location of every parcel as a bounding box. Which computer vision capability should the company use?

options.why: Captioning returns one sentence that describes the whole image. It does not return locations.
Tags list what appears in the image but do not say where each item is.
Correct. Object detection returns a label, a confidence score and a bounding box for each object.
OCR reads text. It does not locate parcels.

questions.explanation: Object detection identifies individual objects and their positions as bounding boxes.

questions.question: You need to extract the printed and handwritten text from scanned delivery notes. Which feature of Azure Vision in Foundry Tools should you use?

options.why: Correct. Read extracts printed and handwritten text with its position on the page.
Dense captions describe regions of an image in words; they do not transcribe text.
Smart crop suggests thumbnail areas. It does not read text.
People detection locates people, not text.

questions.explanation: The Read feature performs optical character recognition on printed and handwritten text.

questions.question: Which TWO tasks require an image-generation model rather than an image analysis service?

options.text: Creating a banner illustration from a text description
options.why: Correct. Producing a new image from text is image generation.

options.text: Listing the objects that appear in a product photo
options.why: Listing objects is image analysis.

options.text: Replacing the background of an existing photo with a beach scene
options.why: Correct. Editing an image to add new generated content is an image-generation task.

options.text: Reading the serial number printed on a device label
options.why: Reading text is OCR, an analysis task.

questions.explanation: Image-generation models such as gpt-image-1 create new images and edit existing ones. Analysis services describe what is already in an image.

questions.scenario: A marketing team publishes images that it created with gpt-image-1 in Microsoft Foundry. Customers want a way to confirm which images were generated by AI.
questions.question: Which feature supports this requirement?

options.why: Correct. Generated images carry C2PA-based provenance metadata that identifies them as AI-generated.
Bounding boxes describe object positions in image analysis results.
Confidence scores show how sure an analysis model is about a result.
Dense captions describe image regions; they do not prove origin.

questions.explanation: Content credentials provide provenance information that shows an image was created by AI, which supports transparency.

questions.question: A support app must let users upload a screenshot of an error and ask, in their own words, what the error means. Which type of model is most appropriate?

options.why: Image-generation models create images. They do not explain screenshots.

options.text: A multimodal model that accepts image input
options.why: Correct. A multimodal model reads the image and the question together and answers in natural language.
Embedding models produce vectors for search and similarity, not answers.
Speech to text transcribes audio, not images.

questions.explanation: Multimodal models such as GPT-4.1 accept images in prompts and can answer open questions about them.
